role: Azure Associate Developer delivering cloud-native solutions that scale.
introduction: I'm a Software Engineer with a passion for building scalable, cloud-native solutions using C#, .NET, and Azure. With over three years of experience across Belgium’s public, banking, and energy sectors, I focus on creating clean, reliable systems that drive real impact.
description:
I build cloud platforms and software delivery systems, with a particular focus on GitHub, Azure, Terraform, and .NET.

Since starting my career in 2020, I’ve worked across Belgian public-sector and enterprise environments, from application development to cloud infrastructure and DevOps. That range lets me connect product needs with the practical work of designing, delivering, and operating reliable software.

Across those roles, I’ve contributed to full-stack services, delivery pipelines, and the infrastructure that supports them, always keeping the day-to-day experience of developers in view. Today, I focus on practical platform foundations that give teams a clearer path from idea to dependable production software. I’m drawn to the point where software engineering, platform engineering, and developer experience meet: making systems easier to build, ship, operate, and maintain.

I enjoy mentoring developers and working with AI-assisted and agentic development workflows that improve how teams create software. Outside engineering, you’ll usually find me travelling around Europe or cooking something unnecessarily elaborate.
